description: Read one prior job, including the prompt that was executed. executedPrompt is that prompt, also stored at requestSnapshot.input.prompt. Text jobs return it when a prompt record was kept and no input payload was stored. Also returns error, diagnostics, receipt summary, and a reuse candidate. Pass job_id from hydracept_jobs_find or an earlier run.
name: hydracept_job_inspect
title: Inspect a prior job
